working_paper: Evolutionary appropriation of physical regularity generates downward causal constraint in a pre-genetic model

scaffold_selection.algorithm: Start with canonical [2,0,3,1]; iteratively select lexicographically smallest remaining permutation maximizing minimum Hamming distance to the already selected set; stop at 4 mappings.

primary_estimator.name: C_down_primary
primary_estimator.definition: JSD_bits(P_intact(S,Z), P_erased(S,Z)); P_erased uses P(S)P(M) with the same P(Z|M,S).
primary_estimator.primary_contrast: Delta C_down = selected - matched neutral at generation 250

alternative_estimator.name: C_down_unitshuffle
alternative_estimator.definition: For each shuffle, independently within each model unit permute motif occurrences across its fixed segment slots, preserving that unit motif multiset and all segment occupancies exactly; pass each scrambled table through the same P(Z|M,S); average JSD_bits(P_intact(S,Z),P_scrambled_k(S,Z)) across K shuffles.
alternative_estimator.primary_contrast: Delta C_down_unitshuffle = selected - matched neutral at generation 250

cross_evaluation.CRN: same local-state uniforms across all four probe scaffolds and across selected-neutral pair for each draw
cross_evaluation.historical_match_score: H = F(historical probe) - mean(F(other three probes)); Delta H = H_selected - H_neutral

statistics.nested: generations, motif windows, local-state draws, alternative-erasure shuffles, cross-evaluation probe draws
statistics.bootstrap_type: nonparametric percentile bootstrap of paired-block effects; stratified by scaffold for pooled summaries
statistics.mapping_family_ci: two-sided 98.75% bootstrap CI per mapping (Bonferroni familywise 95% across 4)
statistics.confirmatory_sign_test: one-sided exact binomial sign test on paired-block effects; exact zero counts as nonpositive
statistics.multiplicity: Holm correction within each four-mapping confirmatory family; A canonical primary is a single prespecified primary endpoint

rng.seed_derivation: uint32 little-endian first 4 bytes of SHA256(project|version|scaffold|replicate|nonce); collision/overlap checked
rng.exploratory_seed_overlap: prohibited and checked against the 20 exploratory sweep seeds
rng.selected_neutral_pairing: same base seed and same purpose streams; mode affects only selection rule
